title: Keep federation page notification summaries consistent with verified wake causes
outcome: Federation page reads do not show a verified wake cause beside a contradictory state-derived notification summary, while preserving stored disposition and receipt/ACK behavior.
acceptance: A production federation page read with retained unconfirmed disposition and verified receiver outcome presents a summary consistent with the cause, without changing receipt, acknowledgement, authorization or wake behavior.
Behavioral regression coverage exercises the page-read path; repository review and exact-input gate requirements are satisfied.
